policies.name: channel_memberships: scoped read
policies.using:
((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM channels c
  WHERE ((c.id = channel_memberships.channel_id) AND (c.owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))))

policies.name: chat_messages: scoped read
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (live_sessions s
     JOIN channels c ON ((c.id = s.channel_id)))
  WHERE ((s.id = chat_messages.session_id) AND (c.owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))
